mapper.select: SELECT l.*, b.id as building_id, b.name as building_name, b.road_address as building_road_address, b.lat as building_lat, b.lng as building_lng, b.built_year as building_built_year, u.id as user_id, u.email as user_email, u.nickname as user_nickname FROM listings l LEFT JOIN buildings b ON l.building_id = b.id LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id WHERE l.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO listings ( title, description, room_type, deposit, monthly_rent, maintenance_fee, area_m2, floor, image_url, status, building_id, user_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{roomType}, #{deposit}, #{monthlyRent}, #{maintenanceFee}, #{areaM2}, #{floor}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{building.id}, #{user.id}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE listings SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, room_type = #{roomType}, deposit = #{deposit}, monthly_rent = #{monthlyRent}, maintenance_fee = #{maintenanceFee}, area_m2 = #{areaM2}, floor = #{floor}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT l.* FROM listings l LEFT JOIN buildings b ON l.building_id = b.id WHERE b.road_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR l.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
SELECT * FROM listings WHERE monthly_rent BETWEEN #{min} AND #{max}

SELECT listing_id FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId}
